Current Research

Currently, I’m working as a research assistant for large-scale genomic data mining at Northwestern to develop an honors thesis for winter 2026. This summer, I will also research under the mentorship of Suzan van der Lee on signal recovery of inaccurately digitized seismograms through a mathematical lens.
